source_value.trigger: The cast header records the command 'mc -x'; the recorded keystrokes are Down (ESC O B) at 1.239s, Tab at 1.980s, F1 (ESC O P) at 2.760s, Escape at 3.558s, ESC O X at 4.346s and Enter at 5.138s.
source_value.start_state: At 0.019s the only output enters and immediately leaves the alternate screen, so the terminal is still empty apart from the block cursor in the top-left corner; the first full paint of mc's two panels arrives at 2.223s with '/.git' already selected one row below '/..'.
source_value.end_state: At 5.150s the two panels are painted again after the typed 'OX' was run in mc's subshell ('zsh: command not found: OX' at 5.148s), with the full hint line 'Hint: Completion works on all input lines in all dialogs. Just press M-Tab.' and the shell prompt below the panels.
source_value.continuity: Nothing moves or resizes: mc rewrites the cells it needs. F1 paints the Help dialog as a bordered box over the middle of both panels and repaints only the covered rows (3 to 27, from column 9), and the panels behind it keep their rows, their selection and their footers when it is dismissed.
source_value.interruption_or_reversal: Escape at 3.558s reverses the F1 help overlay: no output follows it until the repaint at 4.346s, in which the Help dialog is gone, both panels are whole again with '/.git' still selected, and the key bar has changed back from '1Help 2Index 3Prev ... 10Quit' to '1Help 2Menu 3View 4Edit 5Copy ...'.
source_value.feedback: Cyan menu bar and numbered function-key bar, the filled path box on the active panel, the cyan selection bar on '/.git', each panel's footer echoing its current row, the free-space line '41G / 1858G (2%)', and the typed characters echoed on mc's command line.
source_value.reduced_motion_equivalent: No animation is used - the four distinct rendered frames (0.0-2.1s empty, 2.2-2.7s panels, 2.8-4.3s help dialog, 4.4s onward panels again) are instant repaints that persist, so the three retained PNGs carry the same information as replaying the cast. No product-level reduced-motion setting appears in the recording.
